There have been 96 prior macro-attempts in this family and 733 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0199/micro-0001 at 1422 parameters and 99.150000%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0194/micro-0002 (discard, 98.910000%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 190 and 206, values -0.0061834818 and -0.0050844797 (difference 1.099e-03), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,421 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 1.106e-03) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
